name: Button
purpose: A control that triggers an action. Four emphasis levels form a hierarchy — primary (highest emphasis, the main action), secondary, tertiary (outlined), and quaternary (lowest emphasis / borderless). Available on-light and on-dark, in a default and a Large size.

props.name: state
props.$note: processing + success seen on primary (rag/success); confirm which states apply to each type.

props.name: size
props.$note: default height 44px; 'Large' variant exists for primary (and likely all types) — confirm Large height.

variants.name: primary
variants.use: Highest-emphasis main action. Solid brand-red fill.

variants.name: tertiary
variants.use: Lower-emphasis action. Outlined (border) on a white fill.

variants.name: quaternary
variants.use: Lowest-emphasis / borderless (ghost) action; shares tertiary background tints on hover/press.

secondary.label: text/on-inverse (NOT text/reverse) — secondary inverts to a light fill in dark, so flat-white text/reverse would be white-on-white; text/on-inverse is #FFF light / #333 dark (decision: Dave 2026-06-19)

tokens.$darkDecisions: (Dave, 2026-06-19) (1) Inverting labels: secondary + primary PRESSED use text/on-inverse, not text/reverse (which stays flat white for primary-on-red). (2) Disabled label on solid buttons (primary/secondary) = text/on-inverse — white on the light disabled fill, #333 on the dark disabled fill (intentionally ghosted; disabled is contrast-exempt). (3) tertiary/border/default dark bumped #474747→#767676 so the outlined button's border stays ≥3:1 (was ~1.9:1, near-invisible).

accessibility.role: button (or link styled as button when it navigates)
accessibility.keyboard: Reachable in tab order; Enter/Space activate
accessibility.focus: Visible focus outline; use default native focus states
accessibility.states: Disabled state must be programmatically exposed; processing/loading should announce status

antiPatterns: Using more than one primary button in a single context (dilutes the action hierarchy)
REVIEW (inferred): using a tertiary/quaternary button for the main action where a primary is expected
REVIEW (inferred): relying on the deprecated on-dark surface tokens long-term (see tokenValidation — on-dark needs migration)

on-dark.summary: On-dark Button primary (641:103685) is almost entirely bound to deprecated tokens — every surface state via interactive (depricate)/on-dark/surface/brand-1/{default,hover,pressed,disabled,processing}, plus text/icon on-dark(depricate) hover/disabled/processing and a couple of on-light(depricate) pressed tokens, and rag (depricate)/success. Only text/reverse + icon/default-reverse are live.
on-dark.migrationPath: The live primary/background/* and rag/success tokens are MODE-AWARE (carry both light & dark values), so on-dark buttons should be rebound to the SAME semantic tokens as on-light (primary/background/*, text/reverse, rag/success) rather than the separate deprecated on-dark surface set. This is the single biggest deprecated-token cluster found so far — escalate as a button-dark migration task before bulk-delete.
